name: MYM Ventas Online
description: Online beauty and personal-care retailer in Uruguay on WooCommerce. Sells hair, hair removal, makeup, perfumes, lashes, skincare, nails and gift boxes. States it reaches anywhere in the country through Mirtrans and Agencia Central; Montevideo courier prices are listed by zone and interior costs are not.
description_es: Comercio online de belleza y cuidado personal en Uruguay sobre WooCommerce. Vende productos para cabello, depilación, maquillaje, perfumes, pestañas, skincare, uñas y cajas de regalo. Indica que llega a cualquier punto del país mediante Mirtrans y Agencia Central; los costos de Montevideo se listan por zona y los del interior no.

ships_to.notes: States it reaches any part of the country via Mirtrans and Agencia Central. Interior costs and times not stated.
